listing.name: Peggle 2 (Xbox Live Arcade) — Peggle 2 for Mac (macprotips)
listing.summary: This beta is reported to have been played through on the developers’ Macs; compatibility with other Macs is unconfirmed. It runs natively on ARM64 with Metal and CoreAudio. Windows and Linux support are not claimed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Supply your own Xbox 360 Peggle 2 XBLA package from Content/0000000000000000/58411436/000D0000/. The exact accepted package and XEX hashes are not established here; check the project’s importer requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the released Peggle2Installer on Apple Silicon macOS13+ and drop in your own package. It uses Apple Command Line Tools to build the app locally into Applications. For a source build, follow setup.sh, install_game and regen.sh with CMake, Ninja and Python3.

warnings: This beta is reported to have been played through on the developers’ Macs; compatibility with other Macs is unconfirmed. It runs natively on ARM64 with Metal and CoreAudio. Windows and Linux support are not claimed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
